neighbours.label: Caribbean history and places in running text: Cuba, Castro, the Bay of Pigs, San Andrés; the same frames about Europe stay quiet
fire:
Cuba's revolution began in the mountains.
On January 1, 1959 Castro entered Havana.
The Bay of Pigs landing failed within three days.
The island is called Providencia and its capital is Santa Isabel.
Fidel Castro attacked the Moncada barracks in 1953.

The Bay of Pigs Museum
On the 19th of April, the invaders surrendered.
Its capital is San Juan and its port is Ponce.
Batista fled from Havana on New Year's Day.
Sailors landed at Los Cayos on the Cuban coast.
quiet:
Ireland's revolution began in the cities.
On January 21, 1919 leaders met in Dublin.
The Gallipoli landing failed within nine months.
The island is called Sardinia and its capital is Cagliari.
Michael Collins attacked the Dublin barracks in 1920.

The Normandy Museum
On the 6th of June, the invaders landed.
Its capital is Oslo and its port is Bergen.
Churchill left from London on New Year's Day.
Sailors landed at Dover on the English coast.

notes: Card: ' Ser' x4, ' on' x3, 'On' x2, 'ser' x2, in Batista and Bay of Pigs paragraphs, San Andrés, Los Cayelos, plus Spanish basketball handles.
